text_blocks.snippet: Coronary artery disease (CAD) medications aim to manage symptoms, prevent complications like heart attacks, and slow or reverse the progression of the disease. These medications include statins for cholesterol management, antiplatelet drugs like aspirin to prevent clots, and medications to manage blood pressure and angina (chest pain).
